verified_facts.text: Andaz Maui at Wailea Resort is a 15-acre retreat in Wailea, Maui with direct access to Mokapu Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Andaz Maui at Wailea Resort, a 15-acre retreat in Wailea, Maui with direct access to Mokapu Beach

verified_facts.text: Multi-tiered infinity pools cascade toward the ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Multi-tiered infinity pools cascade toward the ocean

verified_facts.text: The resort is design-forward and inspired by the Hawaiian beach house aesthetic.
verified_facts.excerpt: A sleek, design-forward resort inspired by the Hawaiian beach house aesthetic

verified_facts.text: Formerly the Renaissance Wailea Beach Resort, the property was transformed by the Rockwell Group and became the Andaz Maui in 2013.
verified_facts.excerpt: Formerly the Renaissance Wailea Beach Resort, this property underwent a $90 million transformation led by the Rockwell Group

verified_facts.text: Every room, suite and villa has a private lanai.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each space features a private lanai, offering breathtaking vistas of Maui's stunning landscapes.

verified_facts.text: Rooms use neutral color palettes and wood furnishings so the tropical setting and Pacific Ocean views take center stage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Neutral color palettes and wood furnishings let the tropical location and Pacific Ocean views take center stage.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have a complimentary minibar with local snacks and nonalcoholic beverages replenished daily.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary minibar with local snacks and nonalcoholic beverages replenished daily

verified_facts.text: Villas include full kitchens, large indoor-outdoor living spaces, private hot tubs, and extras like bunk bed rooms and game areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Villas include full kitchens, large indoor-outdoor living spaces, private hot tubs, and playful extras like bunk bed rooms and game areas

verified_facts.text: Ground-floor Ilikai villas have a spacious lawn with a private plunge pool and Viking outdoor grill.
verified_facts.excerpt: These unique ground floor units offer a spacious lawn with a private plunge pool and Viking outdoor grill.

verified_facts.text: The Two Bedroom Ocean Front Villa has a loft room designed for kids with two loft beds.
verified_facts.excerpt: a playful loft room designed with keiki (kids) in mind, offering two cozy loft beds for children

verified_facts.text: Awili Spa & Salon offers restorative massages, beauty services and treatments inspired by island botanicals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose from restorative massages, beauty services and rejuvenating treatments inspired by island botanicals

verified_facts.text: The Cabana Experience offers a private poolside cabana with plush seating and personalized service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy your private oasis with plush seating and personalized service while refreshing drinks and shade elevate your poolside day in paradise.

verified_facts.text: The Feast at Mokapu luau is a beachfront feast on the resort's lawn by Mokapu Beach, telling the story of Hawaii's Polynesian ancestors arriving on Maui.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set among the iconic grassy lawn of Andaz Maui at Wailea Resort and the shores of Mokapu Beach, the beachfront feast invites guests to go on an intimate journey of Hawaiʻi’s Polynesian ancestors arriving to Maui

verified_facts.text: At the luau, guests are served a three-course plating of traditional Hawaiian dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests can indulge in a three-course plating of traditional Hawaiian dishes expertly prepared by the culinary team

verified_facts.text: The Art of Poke is a hands-on experience where guests craft their own poke with the culinary team using fresh local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: With our expert culinary team, craft your own creation using fresh local ingredients in an elevated, hands-on tasting experience.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers ocean activities like snorkeling and Hawaiian canoe experiences along Mokapu Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set along Mokapu Beach, the resort offers ocean activities like snorkeling and Hawaiian canoe experiences.

verified_facts.text: Ka'ana Kitchen is the signature restaurant, built around an open kitchen and sourcing from local farmers, artisans and fishermen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our mission is to support local farmers, artisans and fishermen by sourcing local ingredients creating an ever-evolving menu. Our open kitchen is the heart of our restaurant.

verified_facts.text: Morimoto Maui, from chef Masaharu Morimoto, serves lunch and dinner in a beachfront setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Morimoto Maui brings a thoughtfully crafted lunch and dinner menu to a laid-back, beachfront setting.

verified_facts.text: Bumbye Beach Bar is set on the edge of the lagoon pool near Mokapu Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on the edge of our lagoon pool near Mokapu Beach, Bumbye is a place where morning slowly drifts into the day.

verified_facts.text: Lehua Lounge is a beachfront lounge among waterfalls with views of Mokapu Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: this elegant beachfront lounge is nestled among crystal clear waterfalls and features handcrafted cocktails, gorgeous views of Mokapu Beach and delectable small bites

verified_facts.text: The hotel welcomes dogs.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are happy to welcome your traveling canine companions.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers connecting rooms, family-friendly amenities and babysitting referrals, though it leans more adult-oriented overall.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, the hotel offers connecting rooms, family-friendly amenities, and babysitting referrals, though it leans more adult-oriented overall

verified_facts.excerpt: The Shops at Wailea and nearby beaches are quick off-property destinations for retail therapy, additional dining options

verified_facts.excerpt: From intimate ceremonies on the beach with views of the Pacific Ocean and West Maui Mountains
